property_summary: For any caller who is the contract owner, any non-zero receiver address that is a contract that accepts arbitrary-sized Ether transfers, and any positive amount, calling sendTo should succeed (not revert) on the reference; the mutant that caps transfers to 1 ether will revert for some fuzzed amounts > 1 ether, so the property is that sendTo does not revert for all admissible inputs while the mutant violates this.
change_summary: Insert a check that caps the maximum transferable amount to 1 ether, preventing larger transfers.
